product_metadata.title: USILAND Christmas Gnome with Music, Singing Dancing Electric Gnomes Decorations for Home, Winter Table Ornament Or Xmas Musical Holiday Gnome Gifts
features: Singing and Swinging: This gnome is not just an ornament. When you turn on the switch, it will walking, sing, and its large body will swing at the same time. It will bring you and your family double happy.
Lively Design: When the song is over, this gnome decor will stop singing and swinging. You just pat it on the butt and it will go on singing and swinging.
Cute bell: Did you spot the bell on the gnome's hat? As it shakes its body, the little bell sound adds charm and fun to it again. Its hat can be bent to your liking.
Size and Material: 15.7 x 7.5 inches. Powered by 3 x AA batteries (batteries not included). The Singing Christmas Gnome is made of knitwear, felt, faux fur and plastic, non-toxic and odorless.

Interesting Gnome Christmas Decorations and Gift: Imagine how excited everyone will be when receiving such great gifts. It can be a Christmas or Birthday gift for your friend. Also it is unique art for decorate christmas festival, home table or shelf.
